preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: adj is a list of lists where each sublist contains the neighbors of a vertex
preconditions.description: The adjacency list representation of the graph.

preconditions.expression: The graph is undirected and connected
preconditions.description: The graph is guaranteed to be undirected and connected, meaning there is at least one path between any two vertices.

postconditions.expression: The function returns a list of vertices
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers representing the vertices that, when removed, disconnect the graph into two or more components.

postconditions.expression: If no such vertices exist, the function returns [-1]
postconditions.description: If there are no vertices that can disconnect the graph, the function returns [-1].
